text.p: Tristar Corp said on Wednesday that its common stock will continue to be listed on The Nasdaq SmallCap Market via an exception from the capital and surplus requirement.
While Tristar failed to meet this requirement as of August 31, 1996, the company was granted a temporary exception from this standard, subject to meeting certain conditions.
The exception will expire on February 28, 1997, Tristar said. If the company is deemed to have met the terms of the exception, it will continue to be listed on The Nasdaq SmallCap Market, it said.

Tristar said it cannot guarantee that its shares will remain listed on the Nasdaq SmallCap market. Its shares would be traded on the Electronic Bulletin Board, if the company's stock was delisted, Tristar said.
